claim_cap: a development positive control on injected NOAA copies; its conclusions never enter a natural-Yahoo capability claim and say nothing about whether natural data carries removable contamination
clean_arm_naming: the clean arm is a *reference*, not an upper bound; the short canon forbids calling it a bound before the reading exists

geometry.support_window_basis: T1's own triple-window geometry (support origins 1104/1152/1200, delayed 1248/1296/1344) is a forecasting origin geometry sited outside the training block and carries no AD event labels, so it cannot serve as the AD Support window; the book's stated fallback -- the last 20% of the training region -- is used
geometry.substrate_choice: the qcal copy is the substrate: its training block is pristine (byte-identical to the qf copy there, and the t1 copy differs from it exactly at the union of the t1 and qcal ledger points), and it already carries the four known Qcal events this book scores against

spec.detector: sliding-window IsolationForest, one model per series
spec.standardization: scalar mean/std from P(B) only, applied unchanged to the untouched Query; std == 0 is replaced by 1
spec.query_rule: decision_function(window) < 0, the threshold frozen at fit time by contamination; never refitted on the Query
spec.event_rule: consecutive anomalous points merge into one predicted event
spec.matching: greedy one-to-one by row overlap against NAB windows; a window is the set of rows whose timestamp falls inside it
spec.primary_metric: macro average of per-series event F1
spec.borrowed_from: a-evolve/AegisTS/Error_Detection/detectors/models/IForest.py -- window+IsolationForest structure only; not its model-selection stack, and not its train/predict normalization asymmetry

consumer.adapter: the runner adds two things the frozen Consumer does not have and must not be edited to have: an oracle fit mask, and the T0/v3 abstention canon for non-finite windows (never fitted, forced not to flag on the Query, excluded from the AUPRC ranking)

injection.nested_dose: positions are drawn once for the largest rate; a smaller rate takes the ordered prefix, so the rates differ in dose and not in placement
injection.delta_scale_dependence: every delta = sign * sigma_multiple * sigma_local(pristine); no injected value is ever used as a scale source

rate_semantics.definition: fraction of the 761 training windows reached
rate_semantics.why: the Consumer is window-based and the repair is a window-level mask; under a point-fraction reading r = 15% would cover every window and leave the repaired arm nothing to fit, so the exam would test nothing

arms.clean: fit on the pristine training block
arms.contaminated_identity: fit on the contaminated block, no repair
arms.contaminated_repaired: fit on the contaminated block with the known injected positions masked out of the standardization sample and out of every window they touch

r05.reading: whether the injected contamination changed the object the Consumer actually fits, and whether the oracle mask undid it

r15.reading: whether the injected contamination changed the object the Consumer actually fits, and whether the oracle mask undid it

r05.reading: share of the Qcal region the Consumer flags.  A detector that flags most of the Query is saturated: its event F1 is then decided by where the flag run happens to break, not by what it learned from the training substrate

r15.reading: share of the Qcal region the Consumer flags.  A detector that flags most of the Query is saturated: its event F1 is then decided by where the flag run happens to break, not by what it learned from the training substrate

verdict.routing: no rate produced a readable repair effect, so the first fault is at the Program/Consumer layer; this is NOT an injection failure: the contamination did change the fitted object (median std inflation 1.076x) and the oracle mask did restore it (median std residual 1.001x), so the exam's mechanics worked and the delayed reading still did not move; the delayed estimand is the suspect: the Consumer flags a median 88% of the Qcal region even in the clean arm, so its event F1 is decided by where a near-continuous flag run breaks rather than by what it learned from the substrate
